description: This source file defines a ProfileFragment class, which is a DialogFragment used to display and edit user profile details such as name, age, weight, and height. It interacts with a MockRepository to fetch and update profile data, inflates a dialog view using ViewBinding, and provides Save and Cancel options.

classes.name: ProfileFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass that provides a user interface to view and edit user profile information within a dialog.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the alert dialog for editing the user profile. Fetches current profile data, inflates the dialog layout, populates the fields, and sets up Save and Cancel actions.
